subject: Portal entropy — evidence pruning and retention mapping
messages:
From: Joe Santos <joe@acmecloud.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence curation / pruning for Vendr profile

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding help last quarter. We're doing a cleanup of our vendor portals and encountering a lot of stale proof and duplicate artifacts in Vendr for Redwood's profile. Before we start deleting old uploads on our side we'd like to align on a short retention/pruning plan so we don't lose any material you expect Redwood to retain (SOC 2 snapshot, SIG mappings, CAIQ fragments).

Could you confirm: 1) the canonical manifest fields Redwood uses (filename, control_id, upload_date, proof_of_possession) so we can match against our inventory; 2) whether you can provide a 48-hour presign window for a one-time bulk upload of replacement artifacts; and 3) any keys/IDs for the CAIQ to SIG mapping that we should keep.

If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute call today to walk through a sample manifest. We're under a procurement deadline and need the cleaned portal by next Friday.

Attachments: none in this message

Cheers,
Joe Santos
Vendor Security Lead — Acme Cloud
joe@acmecloud.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>

Hi Joe — thanks for the heads up and the clear ask. Short answers up front: we can supply the manifest template and we can open a 48-hour presign upload window from our S3 for a bulk handoff. We also have a lightweight CAIQ->SIG crosswalk we've used for past handoffs.

Proposed next steps:
- Priyom will attach the canonical manifest template (CSV) and the presign instructions.
- Marissa will coordinate the upload window and verify which SOC 2 snapshots need to remain live in Vendr (we usually keep the most recent two snapshots).
- Joe / Acme: send a sample manifest back after you map your inventory; we'll validate and then we can open the presign.

I can do a quick 20-min call today at 11:00am PT if that works for your team — otherwise tomorrow morning PT.

Thanks —

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 10:02 AM Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I can do a quick 20-min call today at 11:00am PT if that works for your team — otherwise tomorrow morning PT.

11am PT works for me. To make the handoff low-friction, here are the mechanics we'll use (summary for the call):

1) Canonical manifest: CSV columns = filename, sha256, control_id (CAIQ id or SIG control name), evidence_type, upload_date, redwood_owner
2) Presign: we'll create a temporary S3 prefix (redwood-vendr-handback/ACME-12345/) and issue presigned PUT URLs valid for 48 hours. We'll provide a text file with the batch of presigned URLs (see attachment).
3) SOC 2 snapshots: we retain last two audited snapshots in Vendr by policy; anything older should be archived. If Acme needs retention beyond 90 days for a specific item, flag it in the manifest and we'll create a retention exception ticket.
4) CAIQ->SIG mapping: we use a compact crosswalk (control_map_v2.csv) — we'll paste the link on the call and include a short mapping file after the call.

Attachments: manifest-v1.csv (template), s3-presign-instructions.txt

I'll be on the 11am call. Rachel / Marissa, please run point on approvals and notify infra to create the presign prefix when we agree.

— Priyom
Product Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Joe Santos <joe@acmecloud.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence curation / pruning for Vendr profile

Hi Joe — follow-up from our call / agreed plan: thanks for walking through the sample manifest earlier. We validated the first 25 rows — the mapping looks good.

Action items we completed:
- Created presign prefix: s3://redwood-evidence/redwood-vendr-handback/ACME-12345/ (48h TTL). Link to upload portal: https://vendr.example.com/upload/ACME-12345
- Attached the manifest template you should use: manifest-v1.csv. Please populate the file and upload to the prefix. Call out any items that need a retention exception using the retention_flag column.
- We will keep the two most recent SOC 2 snapshots live in Vendr; we pulled old snapshots into an archive bucket (available on request).

Attachments: manifest-v1.csv, s3-presign-instructions.txt

If you hit any permission errors during the upload, send the request to security-ops@redwood.ai and we'll triage immediately.

Best,
